newsitem.title: USA: Nuclear Metal sees lower Q2 revs, restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Nuclear Metal sees lower Q2 revs, restructuring.

text.p: Nuclear Metals Inc said Thursday revenue for the second quarter ended March 31 is expected to be below the first quarter, but full year revenues should be higher than fiscal 1996.
The company also said it is considering a reorganization and a change of corporate name.
It is considering putting some technologies and associated personnel into separately incorporated units to facilitate independent financing of the technology and finding potential corporate partners.

The company said that, while any restructuring is still in the conceptual stages, it is committed to obtaining the capital and partners it needs, whether by increasing shares for trading or isolating part of its business to attract investors interested only in certain technologies.
The company added that its previously-announced two-for- one stock split, with shares distributed as a stock dividend, will be payable April 7 to stockholders of record March 3.
